from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u047/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [grid[0]] + list(grid) + [grid[-1]]
    rows = rows[1:-1]  # preserve center rows; duplicate only outer rows
    expanded = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        row_mult = 2 if i in (0, len(grid) - 1) else 1
        out_row = []
        for j, value in enumerate(row):
            col_mult = 2 if j in (0, len(row) - 1) else 1
            out_row.extend([value] * col_mult)
        expanded.extend([out_row] * row_mult)
    return expanded
'''
path=program_dir/'task-65b45593.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'), globals())
